featured_reviews.name: SUSHANT JEDHE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had a very good experience with the HDFC Bank Home Loan team at the Borivali branch. Every time I visited, the staff were helpful, professional, and guided me properly through the process. The service has always been smooth and efficient.

One thing I really appreciate is that the branch is not very crowded, so the work gets done quickly without long waiting times. Compared to the Lower Parel branch, where you often have to spend hours due to heavy rush, the Borivali branch is much more convenient.

Overall, I’m very satisfied with the service and support provided by the team here. I would definitely recommend the Borivali branch to anyone looking for a home loan with HDFC Bank.
